name: Besseggen ridge
why: Norway's best-known ridge: between the green lake Gjende and the blue Bessvatnet, then up a steep rocky crest, after a boat ride from Gjendesheim.
book: Free: the Norwegian right to roam (allemannsretten). Paid parking at the trailhead. Boat from Gjendesheim to Memurubu (book in summer). Bus to Gjendesheim from Otta.
water: Streams near Memurubu and on the plateau.
dangers: Steep scrambling with hands up the ridge, exposed in places.
Weather turns fast: fog, rain and wind even in July. Check yr.no and turn back in fog.
Snow on the north side until July.
turnaround: If the ridge is in fog or wet, stay on the lake path back.
